## Introduction

This document is intended to track notes on the structure of the jsmp and the coding involved in processing it.

## Getting Started

Run `scripts/init.R` before you running any analysis. But don't run it for any downloading or cleaning scripts.

```{r}
source("scripts/init.R")
```
## Directories

Most relevant functions are stored in R files in /scripts.

The directory `data-raw` has a `downloads` folder for information scraped from the web, `schema` for administrative files for saving settings and parameters for functions, and `data` for cleaned data.

## Downloading pdfs

The script `download_pdfs.R` will download the pdfs from the site and create a csv file inventorying the pdfs.
